        cs=list(cells)

                for o1,o2 in zip([others[0]],[]):
                    pass
            break
        for a in cs:

            # o1 and o2 must be orthogonal neighbors of a
            if (others[0][0]==a[0] or others[0][1]==a[1]) and (others[1][0]==a[0] or others[1][1]==a[1]) and others[0]!=others[1]:
